详情: [{"type": "text", "text": "The most powerfully repellent glass coating in the Glaco series! This new formulation is even easier to apply! This is the next generation of Glaco! Using the newly developed S.A.R.F. (Strong Adhesion + Rapid Finish) technology, the latest generation of Glaco creates an ultra-smooth layer that pushes away rain more powerfully than ever before... and it lasts for 4 months! The swivel-head and large, square application felt allow for much easier application and make sure the corners get a proper coat. Also repels traffic film, snow, and frost! Name of product: Glaco DX Content: 110ml Ingredients: Alcohols, siloxanes, acids Storage and disposal: Store below 40℃, out of direct sunlight. Do not store in your vehicles. Use/release contents completely before disposing according to local regulations. How to use the product: 1. Wash away dirt and dust, and dry completely before application. 2. Press onto the glass and gently squeeze to release the liquid, allowing it to soak into the felt head. 3. Apply to the glass in a criss-cross pattern, squeezing to release more liquid as necessary. Leave no gaps. 4. Dry for 5-10 minutes, and wipe up with a tightly-wrung out damp towel. Precautions for use: 1. Avoid contact with other surfaces. If contact with body occurs, wipe away immediately. 2. Direct away from body and eyes when opening. 3. Do not look directly into felt head opening. 4. Do not use in bright sunlight or when glass is hot. 5. Avoid use or use interior heater to warm glass. 6. If glass is wet, effectiveness will be compromised. Please dry surface thoroughly before use. 7. Liquid may be repelled if overabundant, or in the presence of other coatings, traffic film, etc. 8. A presence of another coating or traffic film will impede effect. 9. Do not leave for extended period before removal and may lead to unevenness and difficulty with removal. 10. Do not use excessive force during application as it may lead to destruction of product, glass, dignity, etc. 11. Do not use except for intended purpose. 12. Not suitable for plastic surfaces. 13. Do not use on specially coated glass or side mirrors. 14. External fogging may occur in certain extreme conditions. 15. Not suitable for interior surfaces. 16. Using the newly developed S.A.R.F. (Strong Adhesion + Rapid Finish) technology, the latest generation of Glaco creates an ultra-smooth layer that pushes away rain more powerfully than ever before... and it lasts for 4 months!

The swivel-head and large, square application felt allow for much easier application and make sure the corners get a proper coat.

Also repels traffic film, snow, and frost!

Name of product: Glaco DX

Content: 110ml

Ingredients: Alcohols, siloxanes, acids

Storage and disposal: Store below 40℃, out of direct sunlight. Do not store in your vehicles.

Use/release contents completely before disposing according to local regulations.

How to use the product:

1. Wash away dirt and dust, and dry completely before application.

2. Press onto the glass and gently squeeze to release the liquid, allowing it to soak into the felt head.

3. Apply to the glass in a criss-cross pattern, squeezing to release more liquid as necessary. Leave no gaps.

4. Dry for 5-10 minutes, and wipe up with a tightly-wrung out damp towel.

Precautions for use:

1. Avoid contact with other surfaces. If contact with body occurs, wipe away immediately.

2. Direct away from body and eyes when opening.

3. Do not look directly into felt head opening.

4. Do not use in bright sunlight or when glass is hot.

5. Avoid use or use interior heater to warm glass.

6. If glass is wet, effectiveness will be compromised. Please dry surface thoroughly before use.

7. Liquid may be repelled if overabundant, or in the presence of other coatings, traffic film, etc.

8. A presence of another coating or traffic film will impede effect.

9. Do not leave for extended period before removal and may lead to unevenness and difficulty with removal.

10. Do not use excessive force during application as it may lead to destruction of product, glass, dignity, etc.

11. Do not use except for intended purpose.

12. Not suitable for plastic surfaces.

13. Do not use on specially coated glass or side mirrors.

14. External fogging may occur in certain extreme conditions.

15. Not suitable for interior surfaces.

16. Wash hands well with soap after use.
